title: runner → studio: a run's step progress
description: Subject evt.run.<session_id>.progress (stream EVT), Nats-Msg-Id <run_id>:<seq>. One per step of a stepping node (the echo node: one per step, step 1..of). A real runner adds phase (what is happening: loading transformer, encoding, sampling, decoding) and eta_s; a phase without steps of its own is sent as step 1 of 1.

node.description: the node of the run's graph that is stepping

phase.description: what the node is doing, for the UI

eta_s.description: estimated seconds until the run finishes
